substeps.caption: Same alloy next: open, brush, vacuum. A material change takes about an hour: vacuum, then wipe everything. Brushes, paper towels and isopropanol only.
Plate off its stud. Never grind or clean it: one plate per alloy, logged (1–3 runs each). A stainless scraper for stuck particles, never plastic.
Once the furnace can be touched (150 °C is too hot): lid open, sealing rod out. Peel the slag from the crucible floor, scrape Al off the shaft, keep the tip smooth.
Strip it: thermocouple, insulation, crucible. Nozzle: look through it for light; unclog with a needle or drill it to Ø0.7; swap it if a new charge would not push through.
Reassemble: nozzle, crucible, insulation, thermocouple, rod. Wipe the O-rings; HEPA filter about every two months (sand tray).
